title: Synology patches critical DSM OAuth flaw (CVSS 9.8) and NGINX HTTP/2 flaw (CVSS 8.1)
what_changed: Fix status updated to the revised Synology advisories (24-25 Nov): fixes now listed for DSM 7.1, 7.2.1, 7.2.2, 7.3 and 7.4; only BeeStation OS 1.5 (and DSM Enterprise 1.0 for the NGINX flaw) remain Ongoing.
